deeper_than_candidates.statement: start with Claude Opus 5.5 for most workloads. Use Claude Fable 5.2 for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work, or when your evals on Claude Opus 5.5 at higher effort still fall short.

Gemini 4 Carbon: Our strongest reasoning model, built for complex software engineering, multimodal knowledge work, scientific reasoning, and cybersecurity defense. Gemini 4 Argon: Our efficient Gemini 4 frontier reasoning model, delivering faster responses and lower token spend per turn compared to Gemini 4 Carbon across complex coding, agentic, math, and science tasks.
GPT-6 Cyber is a major step up from GPT-5.6 Cyber and outperforms GPT-6 Astra on most cyber tasks, even when Astra does not refuse the request.
